# opnsense_ids_user_rule (Data Source)

Custom Suricata rules matching addresses or TLS fingerprints (**Services ▸ Intrusion Detection ▸ Administration ▸ User defined**). Changes are applied with a rule reload.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the IDS user rule.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action: `alert`, `drop` (IPS modes only) or `pass`.
- `bypass` (Boolean) With `pass`, bypass the rest of the flow (no further inspection).
- `description` (String) Description, used as the rule message.
- `destination` (String) Destination address or network, empty for any.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA1 fingerprint of a TLS certificate, as 59 colon-separated hex characters.
- `source` (String) Source address or network, empty for any.
